socfpga_clk_mngr_ll.h

Low-level clock manager interface. It reads clock rates and gets or sets clock dividers.

Constants
Clock type identifiers

Values passed as the clock type to the divisor get and set calls.

L4_SYS_FREE_CLK

L4 system free clock.

L4_MP_CLK

L4 MP clock.

L4_SP_CLK

L4 SP clock.

SOFT_PHY_DIV

Soft PHY clock.

CCU_DIV

CCU clock.

MPU_PERIPH_DIV

MPU peripheral clock.

CS_CLK

CS clock.

CS_TRACE_CLK

CS trace clock.

CS_PDBG_CLK

CS PDBG clock.

PLL clock sources

Values compared with the clock source field. A match selects which PLL the driver reads.

MAIN_PLL_CLK_SRC

Main PLL.

PERI_PLL_CLK_SRC

Peripheral PLL.

OSC1_CLK_SRC

OSC1 clock source.

INTOSC_CLK_SRC

Internal oscillator clock source.

FPGA_CLK_SRC

FPGA clock source.

INVALID_CLK_SRC

Clock source is not valid.

VCO clock sources

Values of the PLL source field. The driver uses them to pick the reference clock.

PSRC_EOSC1_CLK

EOSC1 clock. Read from boot scratch. If that read is 0, the driver uses 25000000 Hz.

PSRC_CBINTOSC_CLK

Internal oscillator. The rate is CLKMGR_INTOSC_CLOCK_RATE_HZ.

PSRC_F2S_FREE_CLK

F2S free clock. Read from boot scratch.

Clock rate constants

Fixed numbers used while a clock rate is computed.

CLKMGR_INTOSC_CLOCK_RATE_HZ

Internal oscillator frequency, in Hz.

QSPI_CLOCK_MULTIPLIER

Scale factor applied to the QSPI clock read from boot scratch.

Types
clock_block_t

Enumerates the supported peripheral hardware blocks managed by the Clock Manager.

clk_mngr_ll_get_clk
int32_t clk_mngr_ll_get_clk(
clock_block_t 
clock_block_name,
uint32_t 
*
pclock_rate
)

Resolves and calculates the operating frequency for a specified clock block.

Parameters
clock_block_name
clock_block_t

The peripheral clock block ID (clock_block_t).

pclock_rate
uint32_t*

Pointer to store the calculated frequency in Hertz.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if the block identifier is invalid.

clk_mngr_ll_set_divisor
int32_t clk_mngr_ll_set_divisor(
uint32_t 
clock_type,
uint8_t 
divisor
)

Programs the hardware divider register for a specific clock control type.

Parameters
clock_type
uint32_t

The control clock type identifier.

divisor
uint8_t

The divisor value to write to the hardware register.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if the clock type is invalid.

clk_mngr_ll_get_divisor
int32_t clk_mngr_ll_get_divisor(
uint32_t 
clock_type,
uint8_t 
*
divisor
)

Retrieves the currently programmed divisor value for a given clock type.

Parameters
clock_type
uint32_t

The control clock type identifier.

divisor
uint8_t*

Pointer to store the retrieved divisor value.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if the clock type is invalid.
